label: early copy-phase steps (outputs 1-3) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on the 2nd and 3rd outputs (recall_idx 1-2 hold ~89% of mass, recall_idx 3 another ~9%), and much more often when many outputs remain (L = 8-9 hold ~83% of mass; to_go 5-7). Never fires during the original phase or on the delimiter, and almost never on the first output (recall_idx 0). Within this window the step is token-dependent: rates are higher when the input is a/i/y or when the output is s/f/j/i/r/b, but no token set gives high precision, so most early-copy steps of long sequences stay inactive (precision ~0.1). Top activations (~0.11) are on recall_idx 1-2 of L=9 sequences.
